versions.changelog:
Initial release of cookie-use: a macOS multi-account session manager for any website.

- Capture, store, list, switch, and apply multiple account sessions (cookies + metadata) across Chrome profiles, isolated browsers, and connected sessions.
- Sessions are stored securely in an encrypted local vault (AES-256-GCM, key in macOS Keychain).
- Supports session sharing, bulk opening, import/export, cross-origin replay, and run-as-agent workflows.
- Delegates browser and cookie operations to the chrome-use utility.
- Provides robust confirmation (Touch ID/TTY prompt) before injecting sessions.
- Automation & CI support via environment variables.
